# B6 cached-worktree icon delivery — PASS-WITH-NOTES

Subject `plan:nav-dev-beside-prod`; request `01a1ce9e-83b1-7b63-bd42-770353e4148f`.  
Corrective head **`a31aa7976aac25cbf34ad097a19cc598ca4bf65c`**, parent `8c451497f4fa452249ebcb8cb32ac91c053f572d`.

## Disposition

**The remaining B6 delivery block on 4fa6ed9da is cleared by this corrective head.** Generated icons now travel with a cached web build, and the manifest-dependent tests no longer silently skip. No new blocker found in the three-file patch. This does not clear unrelated trace-idle, ctx-ranking, canonical-query or strip findings.

The source change is narrow: Turbo build outputs add `public/icons/**`; `.gitignore` explains generation/cache restoration; four loadManifest cases lose their conditional skip. The existing generator, sentinel and loader remain the single convention. No reviewer production build, FFT, lint or formatter was run.

## Exact-head fresh-cache evidence

The first supplied `chainglass-icons-b` artifact was historical head `8f60f100e71a7a681251906e05819d92aaededb8`, parent 4fa. Although its three B6 files match a31, its overall source differs in 53 files; it was not credited as exact-a31 assembled-runtime evidence. The author supplied a new detached **`chainglass-icons-c` at exact a31**, which closes that provenance gap.

`B6FreshEvidenceReview` read every file in `/tmp/dev-beside-prod-artifacts/b6-a31-fresh/`, including the entire **415-line build log** and **640-line production log** raw through EOF. The receipts establish:

- Icons absent before and after install in the fresh worktree.
- `just build`: seven successful tasks, six cached; **web HIT `f45e9d35fe26bbd2`**, matching the web MISS actually executed by the canonical a31 FFT. CLI alone missed. Generator text replayed in the cache-hit log is **not fresh generation**.
- Cache metadata records exact a31 and `dirty_hash:null`; its output manifest contains **1119 icon files**, including manifest and theme `.version` sentinel.
- Restored manifest is **414175 bytes**, version **5.32.0**. Its SHA-256 independently matches the canonical copy: `19ad96a4716ec0c4c2d5abdf155161a0bd63340f966c055fd07ea3f367ffb454`.
- Author `PORT=3134 just prod`: FULL TURBO 7/7 cached; promoted `.next-prod-3134` with `.complete`, no staged directory; production-mode registry entry; Next 3134 and sidecar 4634. Promoted, fresh canonical and original canonical builds all identify **`xALJRKydAbHtGghoOU2ZV`**.

I independently recomputed **all seven fresh-package checksums**, plus canonical/restored manifest hashes. Every recorded hash matched. `/tmp/reviewer-b6-fresh-hashes.json` preserves the full fingerprints. No inference that a cache hit compiled the web application was made.

The package's `06-runtime.txt` captures a running entry, not teardown. Author port/socket cleanup was initially only a report; my subsequent lsof found **3134 and 4634 unbound**. No author process was stopped by the reviewer.

## Independent assembled runtime

Served the retained **promoted** `.next-prod-3134` directly using `CHAINGLASS_DIST_DIR` on an owned nice-19 **3200** process—no build or second promotion. With a fresh isolated Chromium profile and browser cache explicitly disabled, unlocked the actual bootstrap popup and opened the file browser on icons-c:

- Manifest HTTP **200 / 414175 bytes**.
- **60 rendered icons, zero broken images**.
- **No console or pageerror entries**, including no IconThemeProvider error.
- **10 ERR_ABORTED request-failure diagnostics**, retained rather than calling the whole network trace error-free.

`/tmp/reviewer-b6-browser-proof.json` and inspected `/tmp/reviewer-b6-fresh-icons.png`. This proves the exercised icon surface, not that every source-theme icon exists. Build warnings still name 28 missing source SVGs; they were not concealed or reclassified as restored assets.

The author separately exercised the actual prod recipe/promotion; my independent run exercised its retained promoted artifact. These are complementary proofs, not a claim that I independently reran the recipe. No native OAuth/LAN/terminal matrix is claimed for this icon-only correction.

## Tests: missing assets are now a hard signal

Independent exact-head icons-c run: **38 tests passed, zero skipped**, 17:46:30, 1.12 s.

Created an owned exact-a31 Git archive without generated assets and linked existing dependencies; no generator/build ran and no author assets moved. Ran only `loadManifest` cases there: **four expected failures**, one expected unknown-theme success, 33 other cases not selected, exit 1 at 17:49:10 / 798 ms. Each of the four formerly conditional tests failed with the actionable **“Icon assets not generated”** error. Thus the absence signal is real execution, not just inspection of removed skipIf text. This deliberate negative-control failure is not a failing check on the provisioned submitted artifact. The disposable snapshot was removed.

## Full gate and historical remediation

`B6GateReview` read the ENTIRE `/tmp/dev-beside-prod-artifacts/b6-icons-fft.log` raw contiguous **1–4288 through EOF**, the complete receipt and all eight SHA256SUMS entries. All eight listed hashes matched. Full log: **348277 bytes**, SHA-256 `500288cdca62b306775c4bc4fdec999d45dcd4d2b457ba2e03f1e3ba2b4efdaf`. Receipt: **182 bytes**, SHA-256 `8bcec093e8aa709498e9edb95ca2a339e0af097e2fe4a7d1979473390e419ac5`.

Receipt records exact-a31 canonical worktree, **17:08:54–17:16:29 / rc=0 / 455 s**, load **35.67→27.54**. Observed gates: biome check/format **1812 files**, no fixes; seven successful builds, **six executed/shared alone cached**; all **nine** workspace tsconfigs; **556 files / 7331 tests passed / 60 skipped**; audit **3 low/16 moderate**, no high/critical. All **38 icon cases ran**. Four earlier manifest skips are gone; the entire increase from 7299 to 7331 is not attributed to B6 because intervening work adds 28 other tests.

Warnings remain: three Turbopack tracing, eight CLI CJS import.meta, color/config/auth deprecations, React act, jsdom and host watcher/negative-path diagnostics. The canonical generator said up-to-date; this FFT alone was not fresh-cache restoration proof—the separate exact-a31 fresh round supplies that.

The earlier **819 descendant FFT already remediated 4fa's missing-later-composed-green requirement**, recorded in amendment `3ff2dae1363c99859bd25f604b5845f05d2fbdfc`. This a31 run is **additional composed-green evidence**, now including the B6 fix and executed icon coverage, not the first remediation. The original 4fa start load **62.60** remains a historical violation of the then-in-force prime policy. Neither later green nor subsequent policy retirement makes that original start retroactively compliant; that threshold was not an AGENTS/Jordan rule.

Current exact source/build observations and retained wrapper receipts are strong corroboration. They do not seal historical environment contents, private TMUX launch settings or artifact bytes that were not recorded at execution time. Successful current runtime and exact cache metadata are kept distinct from those ceilings.

## Cleanup and next action

Owned 3200 process and browser stopped; final lsof found 3134/4634/3200 unbound. Private mode-700 TMPDIR and explicit private-socket preflight preceded Next; no sidecar or tmux session was started by the reviewer. No product files modified, no Jordan server/default tmux touched. Missing-assets snapshot removed. Release reviewer holds on icons/icons-b/icons-c and the old env artifact, subject to prime retention.

Next: review corrective ctx `69031952b`, then canonical-nav `f23b70f58`, then landed trace regression correction `31d1584fa`.
